title: Adobe Paid $1 Billion for a Deal That Never Happened
thumbnail_text: $1 BILLION / FOR A DEAL THAT NEVER HAPPENED
captions: VIDEO_002_CAPTIONS_EN.srt (optional; captions are burned into the picture)
pinned_comment: Adobe never acquired Figma, but the $1 billion was paid anyway — because a clause negotiated in 2022 priced the risk that regulators would stand in the way. Was the $1B a bad bet for Adobe, or a fair price for Figma's risk? Sources and credits are in the description.
